name: Pre-College Program, O'Malley School of Business
org: Manhattan University O'Malley School of Business
what_you_do: Take a business course on AI, management, marketing, finance or your own business research. You earn 3 college credits that can transfer. It mixes online weeks with one week on campus in New York City.
grades: Rising sophomores, juniors and seniors (the page also says the program is designed for juniors and seniors)
who_can_apply: Motivated high school students. The page lists students going into 10th, 11th or 12th grade.
pay_detail: 2026 cost: $6,000 tuition. A residential option adds $1,000 per week for room and board ($7,000 total).
duration: 2026 session: June 22 to July 31, 2026, with a one-week in-person intensive July 13-17, 2026 plus five weeks online
deadline_text: 2026 dates: domestic applications were due May 30, 2026 with answers by June 15; international applications were due March 16, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the pre-college sign-up form linked on the O'Malley program page when it reopens.
notes: Manhattan University is in Riverdale in the Bronx. Check the page for 2027 prices and dates.
